text: When the night covered him, he saw a star. He said: This is my lord. But when it set, he said: I like not those that disappear.
The moon set. The sun set too.
And Prophet Ibrahim, alayhis salaam, said: Indeed, I have turned my face toward He who created the heavens and the earth.
Everything you lean on will set. Lean on the One who never does.
